comment: The catalogue of verticals. The hub renders its directory from this file at runtime, so adding an app is a data change, not a code change. slug must match the directory under apps/, the window.BH_APP_ID the app declares, and the tier_app value the billing backend returns — a Pro subscription is matched against that id.

apps.name: Casebook LMSW
apps.blurb: 207 terms, 217 exam vignettes with rationales, spaced-repetition drills, and a tutor that runs on your own device.

coach.forYou: You hold or are finishing an MSW and are sitting the master's-level social work exam.
coach.notFor: If you are sitting the clinical exam after your supervised hours, Casebook LCSW is written for that.

apps.name: Casebook LCSW
apps.blurb: 159 terms and 84 clinical scenarios for the clinical social work licensing exam.

coach.forYou: You have an MSW plus post-degree supervised clinical hours and are sitting the clinical exam.
coach.notFor: If you have not started supervised hours yet, the master's-level exam comes first — that is Casebook LMSW.

apps.name: Casebook LBSW
apps.blurb: 125 terms and 52 scenarios for the bachelor-level social work exam.

coach.forYou: You hold or are finishing a BSW and are sitting the bachelor's-level social work exam.
coach.notFor: If you went on to an MSW, sit the master's-level exam instead — that is Casebook LMSW.

apps.name: Casebook Nursing
apps.blurb: 115 terms and 200 clinical scenarios for NCLEX-RN and NCLEX-PN.

coach.forYou: You are sitting NCLEX-RN or NCLEX-PN. Both are in this one app — the content overlaps heavily and the app marks what is RN-only.

apps.name: Forge Cloud
apps.blurb: 120 terms and 90 scenarios for AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Google Professional Cloud Architect, and Azure Solutions Architect Expert.

coach.forYou: You are certifying as a cloud architect — designing what runs where, and what it costs.
coach.notFor: If your day is running the clusters rather than designing them, Forge Systems is the closer fit.

apps.name: Forge Security
apps.blurb: 120 terms and 90 scenarios for CISSP, CompTIA Security+, and Certified Ethical Hacker.

coach.forYou: You are sitting CISSP, Security+ or CEH. All three are in this one app.

apps.name: Forge Systems
apps.blurb: 120 terms and 90 scenarios for CKA/CKAD Kubernetes, Terraform Associate, and Linux Foundation Certified Engineer.

coach.forYou: You are certifying on the running of infrastructure — Kubernetes, Terraform, Linux.
coach.notFor: If the exam is about designing cloud architecture rather than operating it, that is Forge Cloud.

apps.name: Forge Management
apps.blurb: 120 terms and 90 scenarios for PMP, TOGAF, and Scrum/SAFe certifications.

coach.forYou: You are certifying in how technical work is planned, governed and delivered.

apps.name: Forge Trades
apps.blurb: 117 terms and 88 NEC-based scenarios for the journeyman and master electrician licensing exams.

coach.forYou: You are sitting the journeyman or master electrician exam, built on the National Electrical Code.

apps.name: Keystone
apps.blurb: 156 terms and 94 practice scenarios for the real estate licensing exam.

coach.forYou: You are sitting a real estate salesperson or broker licensing exam.

decisions.question: Which exam has your board told you to sit?
decisions.note: ASWB writes the exams; your state board decides which one you sit and what it calls the licence. The same three letters mean different levels in different states, so this asks which exam you are taking — not which one you qualify for. If your board has not told you yet, say so below.

options.label: Bachelors
options.detail: Usually the exam taken after a BSW. Your board confirms it.

options.label: Masters
options.detail: Usually the exam taken after an MSW, before post-degree supervised hours. Your board confirms it.

options.label: Clinical
options.detail: Usually the exam taken after an MSW plus post-degree supervised clinical hours — diagnosis, therapy, direct practice. Your board confirms it.

escapes.label: Advanced Generalist
escapes.detail: Usually the exam taken after an MSW plus post-degree supervised hours in macro work — administration, policy, community organising, supervision.
escapes.says: Advanced Generalist and Clinical sit at the same level: they are a fork, not a ladder, and yours is the macro one. None of these three apps is written for Advanced Generalist. There is real overlap with Casebook LMSW in the human development and ethics material, but it carries none of the program development, supervision or administration content — compare it against the ASWB content outline for that category and judge for yourself before relying on it.

escapes.label: Associate
escapes.detail: Used by only a few jurisdictions, usually after an associate degree in social work or credits toward a BSW.
escapes.says: None of these apps is written for the Associate exam. Casebook LBSW is the nearest on content, since the bachelor's-level material overlaps. Before you buy anything, check two things with your board: that the Associate exam is the one it requires of you, and how far its outline differs from the bachelor's one.

unsure.label: My board has not told me yet
unsure.detail: Or I am not certain which of these applies to me.
unsure.says: Then find that out before you buy anything. Your board's website states which exam it requires, and it takes about five minutes. It is worth the five minutes: the levels test different material, and studying the wrong one is wasted work. Nothing here expires while you check — the free tier is open on all three apps, with the full glossary, unlimited drills and a ten-question practice set, no account and no card. Come back when you know.

options.label: Running it
